summary: The change reads the deleted-managed-client tombstone before creating or updating a legacy override record, skips tombstoned IDs, and adds the tombstone to the atomic check. A regression test exercises stale legacy data after deletion and verifies the client stays unavailable. No defects found.

evidence: src/auth_store.ts:585-588 gets deletedManagedClients/<clientId> and continues before reading or writing the managed client record, so stale client_domains cannot recreate a tombstoned client.
src/auth_store.ts:646 includes the tombstone in the atomic check, so concurrent deletion prevents a stale migration write.

tests/bun_test.ts:144-198 deletes a client, adds stale legacy domains and display names, then asserts migration returns 0, leaves no managed record, preserves the tombstone and audit, and keeps effectiveClient null.
